findings.problem: Probe _run has no stdin input, so python -I -B - never receives CHILD_SOURCE.
findings.required: Pass exact CHILD_SOURCE encoded UTF-8 to subprocess.run input on child invocation; retain no-input mode for installer.

findings.problem: Child filters every path underneath repo_root, removing the locked Python 3.13 .venv site-packages and jsonschema/referencing dependencies.
findings.required: Filter exact project roots and their src trees, checkout/build copies and known editable source paths; preserve locked runtime dependency site-packages. Require all imported video_paper_wiki origins under the fresh install target.

findings.problem: Probe failure raises before saving run records; stdout/stderr are hashed but neither their bytes nor child source pin are preserved.
findings.required: Reject existing evidence/log output paths before installations; preserve separate actual install/probe stdout/stderr and execution records on failure, attempt both bounded runtimes independently, finally fail if any failed. Record exact CHILD_SOURCE size/hash and runner pin.

findings.problem: Probe does not recheck frozen source manifest before and after actual wheel runs.
findings.required: Reuse manifest_guard before/after and recheck candidate/wheel/RECORD pins after both runs; do not mutate candidate or baseline.
